rows.gloss_cn: 交往、来往(与人相处);言谈、谈吐
rows.gloss_en: social intercourse or the company one keeps; also one's manner of talking
rows.modern_en: an informal spoken exchange of news and ideas
rows.example_en: His constant conversation with rough sailors soon spoiled his manners
rows.example_cn: 他终日与粗野的水手来往,不久便把性情带坏了

rows.gloss_cn: 明显地、真切地(可觉察地)
rows.gloss_en: in a way that can be clearly perceived or keenly felt
rows.modern_en: in a reasonable or practical way
rows.example_en: The cold crept in so sensibly that he drew his coat the tighter
rows.example_cn: 寒气分明地侵来,他便把外衣裹得更紧

rows.gloss_cn: (古·多为)企图、擅自要求(权利)、僭称;个别处才是“假装”
rows.gloss_en: to presume, aspire, or lay claim to (a right); occasionally to feign
rows.modern_en: to give a false appearance of something
rows.example_en: He would not pretend to any command over the other men on the island
rows.example_cn: 他并不图谋对岛上其余人发号施令

rows.gloss_en: a fit of anger or violent agitation of feeling
rows.modern_en: a strong feeling of enthusiasm or love
rows.example_en: Her sharp words threw him into a great passion
rows.example_cn: 她那尖刻的话把他惹得勃然大怒

rows.gloss_en: to allow or permit something to happen
rows.modern_en: to undergo pain, harm, or hardship
rows.example_en: He would not suffer them to touch his store of powder
rows.example_cn: 他决不容许他们碰他的那批火药
